name: Return to Marleth
label: Quest
description: Marleth waits in Brewnall Village for the Thunder Ale brought from Kharanos. You return with proof that her Scalder reached the Thunderbrew cellar.

clips.title: The story
paras: Marleth waits in Brewnall Village for the Thunder Ale brought from Kharanos. You return with proof that her Scalder reached the Thunderbrew cellar.

Marleth Barleybrew of Brewnall Village wants proof that her Scalder was slipped into the Kharanos cellar, where the distillers make Thunder Ale. You bring back a barrel of their brew, taken from beneath their noses. The prize proves the switch succeeded and gives Marleth a trophy from her rival.

You haul the heavy keg over the snowy ridges to Brewnall Village, where Marleth is thrilled by the caper. She delights in having outsmarted Kharanos's guards and cellar masters. The stunt puts the fierce pride dwarven families take in their signature recipes on display across Dun Morogh.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Having inserted a barrel of Marleth's Scalder in the Kharanos Distillery's cellar, you grab a barrel of Thunder Ale as proof of the deed...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Not bad, friend! Did you have a hard time getting past their guard?
No matter--many thanks, and if you're ever in need of stout with a kick, don't forget the Barleybrews!
